title: Simple personal bookmark manager
scenario: Single clear option: a small, well-understood problem where one simple architecture is enough. Offering three options would be padding.
idea: A tiny web app to save links with a title and a few tags, and find them again later. Just for me.

brief.problem: Save web links with a title and tags, and find them again.

must_have.text: Save a link with a title and tags
Filter saved links by tag and by text

nice_to_have.text: Import bookmarks exported from a browser

assumptions.reason: It is described as 'just for me'
